jd_ml_engineer.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jd_ml_engineer.text: We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build and deploy ML models in production. Must have 5+ years of Python and hands-on machine learning experience (PyTorch or TensorFlow), including NLP. Experience with MLOps and large-scale data pipelines is a plus.

jd_backend_python.title: Backend Engineer (Python)
jd_backend_python.text: Backend Engineer to build scalable REST APIs and services. Strong Python and relational database (PostgreSQL) skills required, 3+ years. Familiarity with Redis, Docker, and microservices preferred.

jd_frontend_react.title: Frontend Engineer (React)
jd_frontend_react.text: Frontend Engineer with strong React and JavaScript/TypeScript skills, 3+ years. You will build accessible, performant UIs. Experience with Next.js and design systems is a plus.

jd_devops_sre.title: DevOps / SRE
jd_devops_sre.text: DevOps/SRE to own our cloud infrastructure and reliability. Must have Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS experience, 4+ years. CI/CD, Prometheus, and incident response experience valued.

jd_data_engineer.title: Data Engineer
jd_data_engineer.text: Data Engineer to build batch and streaming pipelines. Must have Spark, Airflow, and SQL, 4+ years. Kafka, Snowflake, and dbt experience a plus.

jd_security.title: Security Engineer
jd_security.text: Security Engineer to lead application security. Must have threat modeling and penetration testing experience, 4+ years. Python and cloud (AWS) security knowledge required.

jd_fullstack_react.title: Full Stack Engineer (React + Node.js)
jd_fullstack_react.text: Full Stack Engineer to own features end to end. Must have React and Node.js with TypeScript, 3+ years. GraphQL, MongoDB, and AWS experience is a plus.

jd_platform_engineer.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jd_platform_engineer.text: Senior Platform Engineer to build our internal developer platform. Must have Kubernetes and Go, 5+ years. Terraform, Prometheus, and AWS experience preferred; on-call and SLO ownership a plus.
